important_note: The previous 64.98 CBC Offline number is a mixed-corruption global-center setting over all 150k severity-5 logits. The proper corruption-wise offline macro evaluation computes one global CBC bias per corruption and averages over the 15 corruptions.
definition: For corruption-wise offline CBC, compute CLIP logits for all 10k images of one corruption at severity 5, subtract the class-wise mean logit vector computed from those 10k logits, evaluate accuracy, and average over 15 corruptions.
